mapper.select: SELECT cus.api_code,cus.type,cus.thread_num,cus.start_date,con.task_service_name,con.push_service_name,con.merge_service_name FROM b_loan_customer cus left join b_loan_customer_config con on cus.customer_config_id=con.id WHERE cus.status=1

SELECT cus.api_code,cus.type,cus.thread_num,cus.start_date,con.task_service_name,con.push_service_name,con.merge_service_name FROM b_loan_customer cus left join b_loan_customer_config con on cus.customer_config_id=con.id WHERE cus.status=1 and api_code=#{apiCode}
